keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Rio Ave 0, Sporting Braga 0.
Diogo Nascimento (Rio Ave) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Víctor Gómez replaces Bright Arrey-Mbi.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Mario Dorgeles replaces Gabri Martínez.
Diogo Bezerra (Rio Ave) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Rio Ave 0, Sporting Braga 1. Ricardo Horta (Sporting Braga) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Francisco Petrasso replaces Julien Lomboto.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Zé Carlos replaces João Tomé.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Brandon Aguilera replaces Sebastian Clemmensen.
Delay in match because of an injury Zé Carlos (Rio Ave).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Ryan Guilherme replaces Zé Carlos because of an injury.
Substitution, Rio Ave. Tamble Monteiro replaces Miguel Patrício because of an injury.
Fran Navarro (Sporting Braga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Vítor Carvalho replaces Jean-Baptiste Gorby.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Denis Huseinbasic replaces Ricardo Horta.
